Values that look like secrets are never read, hashed or stored, and credential stores (SAM, SECURITY, shadow files, private keys) are refused, but what remains can still contain user names, host names, paths and program command lines. It is capped per device and for the whole fleet and old records are deleted; choose the presets you need, keep retention short, and watch the storage figure shown here before turning it on for a large fleet.

constants.FILE_TRANSFER_RISK: File transfer lets technicians copy files off managed devices and lets administrators put files onto them. Anything inside an allowed folder can leave the device, including documents that hold customer or personal data, and a file sent to a device can be a program that runs later. Password databases, private keys, system credential stores and the agent's own files are never transferable, and every transfer is written to the audit log, but a copied file cannot be un-copied. Allow only the folders you need, keep the size limit low, and turn this on only if your security policy permits it.
constants.LOGS_STORAGE_WARNING: Log collection stores the text of event-log and system-log entries from every device that sends them, in this server's database. It is the heaviest optional part of the RMM: it multiplies database size and write load by the number of devices, and log text can contain user names, addresses and other personal data. Collection is capped per device and for the whole fleet and old entries are deleted, but choose narrow sources (warnings and errors from a few channels or services), keep retention short and watch the storage figure shown here before you turn it on for a large fleet.
